newsitem.title: JAPAN: Stock fall may affect bank earnings, loan woes - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Stock fall may affect bank earnings, loan woes - BOJ.

text.p: Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita said on Friday that the fall in Tokyo share prices may affect banks' ability to deal with problem loans, as well as affecting their earnings results.

"Stock price falls may reduce financial institutions' unrealised profits on shareholdings and may also boost the amount of problem loans to be dealt with. Thus, we cannot ignore the impact these things may have on financial institutions and their earnings results," Matsushita said.
The governor, speaking to a key budget committee of the Upper House of parliament, said that financial institutions were actively dealing with problem loans.
He added that the disposal of problem loans by financial institutions was progressing steadily.

But he said the financial institutions were affected not only by stock prices but by various other factors such as interest rates and currency movements. The impact of these factors on each firm varied, Matsushita said.
He urged banks to make efforts to strengthen their business.
